rules: official domain only; no account numbers transcribed; verification self_reported

nepal-red-cross-society.quote: Ways to Donate To Nepal Redcross
nepal-red-cross-society.note: NRCS homepage nav 'Donate' link points to donation.nrcs.org, a general donation portal with payment options (card, IRAISER). No flood-specific campaign/fund selector found on the donation page itself; homepage separately carries flood situation-update news items but those carry no donate CTA of their own.

ifrc.note: Retrieved via Firecrawl (native WebFetch was blocked with 403/SSL errors on this domain across two prior attempts). ifrc.org/donate lists 'Donate to a specific emergency response' with 'Nepal: Flash Floods 2026' as a named option among 2026 emergencies. That specific link's actual checkout is off-domain at donate.redcrossredcrescent.org — per the domain rule this off-domain checkout URL is NOT recorded; the on-domain ifrc.org/donate page (which names and links the Nepal option) is recorded as value instead, same pattern as the direct-relief entry.

direct-relief.quote: 100% of donations to the Nepal Flood Relief Fund support this response
direct-relief.note: Dedicated Nepal floods 2026 appeal page with a 'Donate to Nepal Flood Relief' CTA. That specific CTA (and directrelief.org/donate generally) redirects off-domain to pro.gofundme.com for actual checkout — that third-party checkout URL is deliberately NOT recorded per the domain rule; the org's own on-domain appeal page is cited instead.

msf-international.note: Only a general donation page found. MSF published a Nepal news article but it has no donate CTA or dedicated appeal link; no Nepal-specific fund found within budget.

save-the-children-international.quote: Donate today to help provide lifesaving support to children in Nepal – and wherever the need is greatest.
save-the-children-international.note: Retrieved via Firecrawl (native WebFetch blocked with 403 across two prior attempts). savethechildren.net/what-we-do/emergencies carries an 'Urgent: Nepal floods' section with preset-amount checkout links dedicated to the Nepal response (both one-time 'Donate once' and monthly 'Give monthly' variants exist on-domain).

unicef-nepal.note: Retrieved via Firecrawl (native WebFetch blocked with 403 across two prior attempts). unicef.org/donate itself is a dead link (404 page); the real donate mechanism is donate.unicef.org/donate/now (subdomain of unicef.org, so on-domain), linked from unicef.org/emergencies beneath the 'Humanitarian Action for Children' appeal description. Checked the Nepal-specific flood page (unicef.org/nepal/flooding-nepal-2026-0) directly — it only links to a flash-appeal document and a press release, no donate CTA — so this is UNICEF's general emergency fund, not Nepal-specific.

wfp-nepal.quote: Donate where the needs are greatest
wfp-nepal.note: wfp.org/countries/nepal carries a news story on the flood response, but donate.wfp.org campaign links found include no Nepal-specific fund — this is WFP's general 'greatest need' donation channel on the wfp.org domain (donate.wfp.org subdomain).

mercy-corps.quote: Help Families Devastated by Floods in Nepal
mercy-corps.note: Homepage banner links directly to this Nepal-specific donate URL. It 301-redirects (geo-routing) to europe.mercycorps.org/donate, a broader multi-crisis form that still lists Nepal — same registrable domain (mercycorps.org) throughout.

project-hope.quote: Deadly Floods and Landslides Devastate Nepal
project-hope.note: Homepage alert-bar DONATE link and a news story both route to this give.projecthope.org page dedicated to the Nepal response.

globalgiving.quote: When you donate to the GlobalGiving Nepal Flood Relief Fund, your donation will:
globalgiving.note: Retrieved via Firecrawl (native WebFetch blocked with 403 across two prior attempts). This is GlobalGiving's own dedicated Nepal Flood Relief Fund project page/donation flow on their platform domain.

oxfam-in-nepal.quote: Around the world, Oxfam is working every day to fight inequality to end poverty and injustice.
oxfam-in-nepal.note: Retrieved via Firecrawl. nepal.oxfam.org itself has no donate mechanism (confirmed again this round). oxfam.org/en/donate is Oxfam International's own donate hub (same registrable domain, oxfam.org, as nepal.oxfam.org) but functions as a country-selector directory — actual checkout for each country happens on that country's own ccTLD (oxfam.org.uk, oxfam.de, oxfam.org.au, etc.), which are different domains and NOT recorded; no Nepal-specific national page exists in that directory. Recording the on-domain oxfam.org/en/donate hub itself as the channel.

care-nepal.quote: HELP FAMILIES IN URGENT NEED. Give now.
care-nepal.note: Retrieved via Firecrawl. carenepal.org itself has no donate mechanism (confirmed again this round — only phone/email contact). Per explicit direction, recording CARE's parent international site care.org/donate/ instead, a live general donation form (one-time/monthly, preset amounts) — NOTE: care.org is a different registrable domain than carenepal.org (CARE USA/International vs. the Nepal country office site), so this is a deliberate exception to the strict same-domain rule rather than a compliant on-domain match; flagged for awareness. No Nepal-specific fund found on care.org.

world-vision-nepal.note: wvi.org homepage links to /donate, a country-selector donation page. No Nepal-specific flood appeal page found on wvi.org.

plan-international-nepal.quote: On the morning of 26 August, a major flash flood and landslide struck parts of northern Nepal and the Chinese border linking Tibet.
plan-international-nepal.note: Retrieved via Firecrawl (native WebFetch blocked with 403 across two prior attempts; plan-international.org/donate/ is also a dead 404 link). plan-international.org/get-involved/ features a 'Nepal flash floods appeal' section with a 'Donate now' link to this dedicated appeal page, which itself carries the full flood narrative. The appeal page's own donate buttons route to national Plan chapters off-domain (planinternational.be, plancanada.ca, plan.org.hk, plankorea.or.kr) for actual checkout — those off-domain URLs are NOT recorded per the domain rule; the on-domain appeal page is recorded instead.

actionaid-nepal.note: Prominent 'Donate now' CTA in nav of nepal.actionaid.org. No Nepal flood-specific appeal found; page covers general programme areas.

habitat-humanity-nepal.note: Re-checked via Firecrawl. habitatnepal.org/rasuwa-flood-2026 IS a real, live page (confirmed reachable this round, unlike the earlier 404 report) but its content is header/footer/contact-info only (phone, email, social links) with no donate CTA, bank details, or appeal narrative in the body — scanned full markdown for donate/bank/contribute keywords, zero hits. /donate still 404s.

caritas-nepal.note: Publishes bank transfer details (NPR and EUR accounts at Standard Chartered Bank Nepal; account numbers not transcribed here). No online checkout form and no Nepal flood-specific appeal; general donate page.

lutheran-world-federation-nepal.quote: Stand with the LWF in supporting local communities worldwide affected by emergencies, including natural disasters, conflicts, humanitarian crises
lutheran-world-federation-nepal.note: Retrieved via Firecrawl (native WebFetch blocked with 403 across two prior attempts). lutheranworld.org/donate-now lists several designated funds (Communion Solidarity Fund, general humanitarian interventions, Ukraine, LWF Jerusalem Program) but none specific to the 2026 Nepal floods; used the general 'Support our Humanitarian interventions' emergencies fund. donate.lutheranworld.org is a subdomain of lutheranworld.org (on-domain).

humanity-inclusion-nepal.quote: Vous souhaitez effectuer un don ponctuel ou régulier ?
humanity-inclusion-nepal.note: hi.org (French locale) carries a news article confirming an Aug 26 2026 Nepal mudslide/flood emergency response, linking to the org's general donation page (multi-country selector, no dedicated Nepal fund).

people-in-need-nepal.quote: We have launched SOS Nepal, an appeal to help people affected by devastating flash floods.
people-in-need-nepal.note: Dedicated 'SOS Nepal' appeal page on peopleinneed.net for the 2026 flash floods, linking to a preset online donation checkout URL on the org's own domain. A bank-transfer alternative is also listed on the appeal page.

wateraid-nepal.note: Retrieved via Firecrawl (native WebFetch blocked with 403 across two prior attempts). wateraid.org/np/donate itself remains inaccessible; found this general donate CTA on the wateraid.org homepage. us.wateraid.org is a subdomain of wateraid.org (on-domain). wateraid.org/np (the Nepal country page) describes WaterAid's work in Nepal but has no donate CTA of its own — general channel only, not flood-specific.

practical-action-nepal.quote: Donate online - With every donation, you'll help turn bold, unconventional ideas into real-world, poverty-beating action.
practical-action-nepal.note: No Nepal-flood-specific 2026 appeal found. /nepal-floods/ 404s; /where-we-work/nepal/ discusses flood-preparedness generally but links to the same generic Donate button.

mountain-heart-nepal.quote: Help our volunteer-run team respond to flash floods in Rasuwa
mountain-heart-nepal.note: Donate page explicitly frames the appeal as an Emergency Response Fund for the current Rasuwa flash floods, with a PayPal option and a bank transfer option (Prabhu Bank Limited; account number not transcribed here).

ngo-federation-of-nepal.note: Re-checked via Firecrawl (homepage crawl, 47 links). No donate/support-us page found among the crawled links; the only Nepal-relevant links are to unrelated third-party sites (WaterAid Nepal country page, World Social Forum Nepal, Nepal SDG Forum). Confirms the earlier finding: a flood appeal post exists but publishes no donation mechanism.

community-self-reliance-centre.note: Re-checked via Firecrawl, including the /campaigns/ page specifically (71 links, 36.7k characters of markdown scanned for donate/bank/contribute/paypal/fundraise keywords — zero hits). The 'campaigns' page turns out to be about land-rights advocacy campaigns, not fundraising campaigns. No donation channel found anywhere on csrcnepal.org.

dhulikhel-hospital.note: Re-checked via Firecrawl — site is reachable (22.3k characters of markdown; a prior Firecrawl attempt this session timed out with 408, but a retry succeeded). Full page scanned for donate/bank/contribute keywords — zero hits. Only a news item titled 'Dhulikhel Hospital's Response To The Devastating Floods And Landslides In Nepal 2026' was found, no donation channel published on either dhulikhelhospital.org or kusms.edu.np.

worec-nepal.note: Dedicated /donate/ page publishes bank transfer details (account number withheld here). No online checkout form and no flood-specific content found — general donation channel only.

non-resident-nepali-association.note: Re-checked nrna.org.np/donate directly via Firecrawl — the page is nearly empty (486 characters), containing only placeholder anchor links to 'Our NCC's Sites' by region (Africa, Americas, Asia Pacific, etc.) that don't resolve to real destinations. Confirms the earlier finding: the actual donation mechanisms (charity.nrna.org, nrna-donate.azurewebsites.net) are off the nrna.org.np domain and therefore not recorded per the domain rule.

nepal-lions-md325.note: Found the flood appeal post 'Recent Flood in Rasuwa (Request for Appeal)' dated 2026-08-27 at lionsclubs.org.np — it names the emergency but publishes no donation link, online form, or bank details, only an email/phone contact. /lcif-area-leader-2/ and /disaster-grants/ describe LCIF/disaster-grant programs generically and link out to lionsclubs.org rather than provide an on-domain donation mechanism.

helvetas.quote: Helvetas is also collecting donations in Switzerland to support those affected.

welthungerhilfe.quote: Eine verheerende Sturzflut hat am 26. August im Norden Nepals zahlreiche Todesopfer gefordert und schwere Zerstörungen angerichtet.

government_funds.name: Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund (Nepal)
government_funds.quote: प्रधानमन्त्री दैवी प्रकोप उद्धार कोष र प्रधानमन्त्री राहत कोषमा आर्थिक सहयोग गरिदिनु हुन
government_funds.note: Nepali text ("...contribute financial support to the Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund and Prime Minister Relief Fund") appears on the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers (OPMCM) homepage, gov.np domain, alongside a QR code for contributions. No bank account number was visible in the extracted text (not transcribed here regardless per the no-account-number rule). Two separate funds are actually named ('Prime Minister Divine Calamity Relief Fund' and 'Prime Minister Relief Fund') — recorded as one entry per the task's ask; could not find a deeper dedicated page for either fund within budget (ndrrma.gov.np, the other candidate checked, does not mention either fund).
